resources.name: Bascom & Cottington (1976) bulk adhesive properties and joint fracture data

access.notes: Table I from Bascom, W.D. & Cottington, R.L. (1976) J. Adhesion 7, 333. Contains temperature, yield stress, modulus, bulk fracture energy, and adhesive joint fracture energy. The solving agent must extract the six rows.

resources.notes: Required for fitting and prediction; the data is publicly available in the cited publication.
